note: 十段连续双语变更草稿；设计：按指标暂停灰度，确认应用回归后回滚已验证制品，保留向后兼容的扩展schema。未配音，不填时间轴。

series.title: 灰度发布：指标暂停与兼容回滚
series.premise: checkout 2.8发布改善报价路径，2.7仍在生产。数据库已做可空字段扩展，必须证明旧代码仍可读写。
series.outcome: 5%灰度出现报价回归，按预设指标先暂停放量，再由发布审批人批准回滚2.7的固定摘要。保留兼容schema，不执行破坏性降级，观察恢复后安排修复和重新审批。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 向后兼容的数据库结构
先扩展后收缩的结构迁移方式

recycling.note: 未来候选不算实际复现；本场实际复现只引用既有库、S03至S07及本场先前段。

dialogues.title: 目标是更快报价，不是尽快全量
dialogues.premise: 2.8报价优化进入发布评审，2.7仍提供全部流量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出灰度范围、预期收益及独立审批要求。

lines.en: Okay, today's staged rollout targets checkout. Start with a five-percent canary cohort.
lines.zh: 好，今天分阶段发布checkout。先用5%的灰度组。

lines.en: We're shortening the quote lookup path. Not changing payment behavior itself.
lines.zh: 我们缩短报价查询路径，不改变支付行为本身。

lines.en: But there's a schema extension involved. Explain that before we approve traffic.
lines.zh: 但涉及结构扩展。批准流量前先解释清楚。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no automatic full rollout? Each increase needs a go/no-go.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不自动全量发布？每次增加都要判断继续还是停止。

lines.en: Yes, compare equivalent requests across versions. Faster averages alone aren't enough evidence.
lines.zh: 对，要跨版本比较等价请求。平均更快本身不够。

lines.en: The maintenance window starts at ten. We have about forty minutes available.
lines.zh: 维护窗口十点开始。我们大约有四十分钟。

lines.en: A window ending isn't a success signal. Leave time for a verified rollback.
lines.zh: 窗口结束不是成功信号。要留出验证回滚的时间。

lines.en: So, I'll keep an eye on quotes. Payment retries retain their existing keys.
lines.zh: 那么我关注报价。支付重试保留现有键。

lines.en: I'll check correctness alongside latency today. Missing metrics mean no further promotion.
lines.zh: 今天我把正确性与延迟一起检查。指标缺失就不能继续放量。

lines.en: Fair, first let's confirm artifact identities. Then we'll review schema compatibility evidence. I'll record the decision in our ticket. Unresolved checks keep traffic unchanged.
lines.zh: 明白，先确认制品身份，再评审结构兼容证据。我把决定记在工单里。检查未决就不改变流量。

dialogues.title: 摘要固定，签名不能代替审批
dialogues.premise: 5%灰度计划待批准；需先核对2.8与回退用2.7制品。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分标签、摘要、签名和发布审批。

lines.en: The immutable artifact is version 2.8. Its digest matches our reviewed release record.
lines.zh: 不可变制品是2.8版。摘要和已评审发布记录一致。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, deploy by digest. Moving tags won't select our release.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，按摘要部署。不能让可变标签选择版本。

lines.en: What about the previous production artifact? Rollback mustn't mean rebuilding old source.
lines.zh: 之前生产制品呢？回滚不能变成重新构建旧源码。

lines.en: The 2.7 digest is retained securely. That's our tested fallback, right?
lines.zh: 2.7摘要已安全保留。这是测试过的回退目标，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, both signatures match approved identities. Provenance links their commits and build inputs.
lines.zh: 对，两者签名都匹配批准身份。来源证明关联提交与构建输入。

lines.en: I'm on it for staging verification. The smoke test used that exact digest.
lines.zh: 预发布验证我来确认。冒烟测试用的正是那个摘要。

lines.en: Keep secrets outside both artifact images. Confirm runtime secret references work for both.
lines.zh: 秘密留在两个制品镜像之外。确认两版运行时秘密引用都可用。

lines.en: So, canary cohort gets no special bypass. Go/no-go still depends on compatibility checks.
lines.zh: 那么灰度组也没有特殊豁免。是否继续仍取决于兼容检查。

lines.en: Secret scanning and runtime checks passed. Signature verification doesn't replace change approval.
lines.zh: 秘密扫描与运行时检查通过。签名验证不替代变更审批。

lines.en: Agreed, roughly ten minutes of evidence next. Let's define the comparison gates clearly. I'll attach the reviewed source commit. That keeps support's version report traceable.
lines.zh: 同意，接下来积累约十分钟证据，明确比较门槛。我附上评审过的源码提交，让支持团队版本报告可追溯。

dialogues.title: 先定样本，再定暂停和回滚
dialogues.premise: 两版固定摘要均通过签名、来源与运行时检查；定义灰度验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分正常放量、暂停及回滚三种条件。

lines.en: The promotion gate needs ten minutes. At least a thousand requests per cohort.
lines.zh: 放量门禁需要十分钟。每组至少一千个请求。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, compare matched requests. Control errors currently sit near point-two percent.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，比较匹配请求。对照组错误率目前约0.2%。

lines.en: Require canary errors below point-five percent. Its p95 must stay below three hundred.
lines.zh: 灰度错误率须低于0.5%。p95必须低于三百。

lines.en: Three hundred milliseconds, right? Control p95 is roughly two-twenty milliseconds today. I'll label the canary cohort explicitly. We must exclude synthetic probe requests.
lines.zh: 三百毫秒，对吧？今天对照p95大约二百二十毫秒。我明确标注灰度组，必须排除合成探测请求。

lines.en: Yes, pause above one-percent errors for two minutes. Or p95 above four hundred likewise.
lines.zh: 对，错误率超过1%持续两分钟就暂停。p95超过四百毫秒同样处理。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger beyond pausing? We mustn't leave bad quotes running indefinitely.
lines.zh: 除了暂停，回滚触发条件是什么？不能一直运行坏报价。

lines.en: Above two-percent errors for five minutes. Confirmed severe correctness failures trigger immediate rollback.
lines.zh: 错误率超过2%持续五分钟。确认严重正确性失败就立即回滚。

lines.en: So, keep an eye on both. Missing samples block promotion, not justify it.
lines.zh: 那么两项都关注。样本不足阻止放量，不是放量理由。

lines.en: Review rollout approval after every observation window. No scheduled timer can approve an increase.
lines.zh: 每个观察窗口后审查放量审批。定时器不能批准增加。

lines.en: What's the ETA if samples arrive slowly? We'll hold five percent until sufficient evidence.
lines.zh: 样本来得慢，预计怎么办？证据充分前保持5%。

dialogues.title: 旧代码读写必须兼容新结构
dialogues.premise: 指标门槛已记录，流量尚未切入；核验数据库回退条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出为何回滚应用不等于删除新字段。

lines.en: We require a backward-compatible schema today. The new quote field is nullable.
lines.zh: 今天要求向后兼容的结构。新报价字段允许为空。

lines.en: Okay, old readers ignore that field. Old writers can still omit it.
lines.zh: 好，旧读取代码忽略这个字段。旧写入代码仍可省略它。

lines.en: Did tests include new-version written rows? Old code must handle those too.
lines.zh: 测试包括新版写出的行吗？旧代码也必须处理。

lines.en: Yes, the mixed-version smoke test passed. We keep the expanded schema, right?
lines.zh: 是，混合版本冒烟测试通过。我们保留扩展结构，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, no dropped columns or renamed types. Don't run destructive down migrations during rollback.
lines.zh: 对，没有删列或重命名类型。回滚时不执行破坏性降级迁移。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that immutable artifact remains available. What's the compatibility rollback trigger?
lines.zh: 确认一下，那个不可变制品仍可用。兼容性回退触发条件是什么？

lines.en: If compatibility evidence fails, stop before deployment. Don't assume binary rollback repairs stored data.
lines.zh: 兼容证据失败就部署前停止。不能假设二进制回滚能修复存储数据。

lines.en: So, no data conversion in this release. Quote values retain their existing representation.
lines.zh: 那么本次不转换数据。报价值保留现有表示方式。

lines.en: And both versions retain request deduplication. Retry after rollback mustn't duplicate payments.
lines.zh: 两版都保留请求去重。回滚后重试不能重复支付。

lines.en: Fair, go/no-go is approved for five percent. Further increases need my explicit approval. Record these compatibility tests with approval. Any different digest invalidates this permission.
lines.zh: 明白，批准5%灰度，后续增加需要我明确批准。兼容测试随审批记录，摘要不同就使本次许可失效。

dialogues.title: 5%流量到达，开始观察窗口
dialogues.premise: 兼容性测试通过，Priya批准5%灰度，保留旧结构和旧制品。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别权重配置成功和真实请求进入灰度。

lines.en: Traffic weight is now five percent. Running pods show the approved 2.8 digest.
lines.zh: 流量权重现在5%。运行Pod显示批准的2.8摘要。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, actual requests arrived? A config update isn't enough proof.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，实际请求到了吗？配置更新不足以证明。

lines.en: Routing counters show the intended split. Existing connections may shift more slowly.
lines.zh: 路由计数显示预期比例。已有连接转移可能更慢。

lines.en: The smoke test reached new pods. I'm checking quote correctness itself now.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试到达新Pod。我正在检查报价正确性本身。

lines.en: Version labels identify both cohorts correctly. The promotion gate clock starts here.
lines.zh: 版本标签正确识别两组。放量门禁的观察从这里开始。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on routing. No additional weight changes are scheduled. The previous digest stays locally available. Registry disruption won't force a rebuild.
lines.zh: 我关注路由，没有安排进一步权重变更。旧摘要在本地保留可用，仓库中断不会迫使重新构建。

lines.en: Database writes remain compatible so far. Check the optional field in new rows.
lines.zh: 目前数据库写入兼容。检查新行中的可选字段。

lines.en: So, let's keep it under observation. A clean first minute isn't release success.
lines.zh: 那么继续观察。第一分钟正常不等于发布成功。

lines.en: Agreed, error counters need adequate volume. Record timestamps rather than rely on impressions.
lines.zh: 同意，错误计数需要足够量。记录时间戳，不靠感觉。

lines.en: Actually, quote errors are appearing now. Maybe one product class is affected.
lines.zh: 其实现在开始出现报价错误。可能影响某一商品类别。

dialogues.title: 总均值正常，灰度报价明显变差
dialogues.premise: 5%灰度已收到请求，初始检查正常，随后出现报价错误。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出分组比较如何避免整体均值掩盖问题。

lines.en: Cohort comparison shows a clear difference. Canary errors reached one-point-four percent.
lines.zh: 两组比较有明显差异。灰度错误率达到1.4%。

lines.en: Okay, traffic weight hasn't changed since approval. Control stays around point-two percent.
lines.zh: 好，批准后权重没有变。对照仍约0.2%。

lines.en: Compare matching product classes and regions. Otherwise traffic mix could distort that difference.
lines.zh: 比较匹配商品类别和区域。否则流量构成可能扭曲差异。

lines.en: Matched discount quotes fail on canary. The error rate spiked there only.
lines.zh: 匹配的折扣报价在灰度失败。错误率只在那里陡涨。

lines.en: Its p95 is four-thirty milliseconds now. Control remains roughly two-twenty, with fresh samples.
lines.zh: 灰度p95现在四百三十毫秒。新鲜样本显示对照仍约二百二十。

lines.en: Just to confirm, how long above thresholds? I'll keep an eye on duration.
lines.zh: 确认一下，超门槛多久了？我关注持续时间。

lines.en: One minute forty seconds so far. We're approaching the two-minute pause threshold.
lines.zh: 目前一分四十秒。快到两分钟暂停门槛了。

lines.en: So, prepare the pause without increasing traffic. Our working hypothesis is quote-path regression.
lines.zh: 那么准备暂停，不增加流量。当前假设是报价路径回归。

lines.en: Don't restart pods to reset evidence. Save traces with sensitive fields redacted.
lines.zh: 别重启Pod重置证据。保存脱敏后的追踪。

lines.en: Fair, no confirmed incorrect charges yet. Failures occur before payment submission begins. I'll check rejected quote samples directly. We shouldn't infer correctness from status codes.
lines.zh: 明白，目前未确认错误扣款，失败发生在支付提交前。我直接检查被拒报价样本，不能从状态码推断正确性。

dialogues.title: 门槛触发就暂停，不靠感觉等
dialogues.premise: 灰度错误率和p95持续升高，即将达到两分钟暂停条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住暂停决定、保持的流量比例及下一次检查。

lines.en: Okay, pause promotion now, thresholds persisted. Keep five percent while we assess rollback.
lines.zh: 好，门槛持续触发，现在暂停放量。评估回滚时保持5%。

lines.en: Promotion is disabled in the controller. Just to confirm, no increase at all?
lines.zh: 控制器已禁用放量。确认一下，完全不增加？

lines.en: Correct, disable the queued increase too. An operator pause must survive controller reconciliation.
lines.zh: 对，也禁用排队的增加操作。控制器同步不能覆盖人工暂停。

lines.en: The promotion gate has failed, right? I'd rather not wait for the window.
lines.zh: 放量门禁失败了，对吧？我不想等窗口结束。

lines.en: We aren't waiting for that window. Evaluate the predefined rollback trigger continuously.
lines.zh: 我们不是在等那个窗口。持续评估预设回滚触发条件。

lines.en: What's the ETA for trace evidence? Maybe two minutes, not another rollout. I'll notify support about delayed quotes. They shouldn't advise repeated payment submissions.
lines.zh: 追踪证据预计多久？可以两分钟，不是再发一次。我通知支持团队报价延迟，不能建议反复提交支付。

lines.en: The discount lookup waits on retries. Retrying a deterministic error won't resolve it.
lines.zh: 折扣查询在等待重试。重试确定性错误解决不了问题。

lines.en: So, let's keep it under observation briefly. The old digest is ready for rollback.
lines.zh: 那么短暂继续观察。旧摘要已准备好回滚。

lines.en: Both cohorts now exceed a thousand requests. Canary errors just crossed two percent.
lines.zh: 两组现在都超过一千请求。灰度错误率刚超过2%。

lines.en: I'll timestamp that crossing for accuracy. Correctness checks still show rejected quotes, not charges.
lines.zh: 我记录越线时间以确保准确。正确性检查仍是报价拒绝，不是扣款。

dialogues.title: 持续越线，审批回滚旧摘要
dialogues.premise: 放量已暂停，灰度错误超过2%；继续计时并核对兼容回滚准备。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出审批人、操作人和保留数据库扩展的条件。

lines.en: Errors exceeded two percent for five minutes. That meets the documented rollback trigger.
lines.zh: 错误率超过2%已持续五分钟。达到记录的回滚触发条件。

lines.en: Okay, let's abort the rollout now. I approve: roll back the release.
lines.zh: 好，现在中止发布。我批准回滚这次发布。

lines.en: The backward-compatible schema remains in place. Old code reads these new rows correctly.
lines.zh: 向后兼容的结构保持不动。旧代码能正确读取这些新行。

lines.en: Let me play that back first. Restore verified 2.7, retain expanded schema, right?
lines.zh: 我先复述：恢复验证过的2.7，保留扩展结构，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, reverify signer and digest before applying. Keep deployment receipts for each operation.
lines.zh: 对，执行前再验签名者和摘要。每个操作都保留部署回执。

lines.en: Just to confirm, stop new canary assignments. Drain active requests without duplicating payments.
lines.zh: 确认一下，停止新的灰度分配。排空在途请求，不重复支付。

lines.en: Keep existing idempotency keys across retries. No destructive migration or blanket data reset.
lines.zh: 重试保留现有幂等键。不执行破坏性迁移或全量数据重置。

lines.en: So, Raj executes under this approval. Stop if compatibility or artifact checks fail.
lines.zh: 那么Raj按这次审批执行。兼容性或制品检查失败就停止。

lines.en: Unknown controller results require state reconciliation. Don't blindly repeat the deployment command.
lines.zh: 控制器结果未知需要核对状态。不能盲目重复部署命令。

lines.en: Understood, applying the recorded operation identifier. Then I'll verify running digests and routing. I won't retry an unknown result. I'll reconcile the controller state first.
lines.zh: 明白，使用记录的操作标识执行，随后核对运行摘要和路由。结果未知我不重试，先核对控制器状态。

dialogues.title: 恢复旧版后仍需看新鲜业务指标
dialogues.premise: Priya批准回滚，Raj恢复2.7摘要并停止新灰度分配，结构保持扩展。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分操作完成、流量恢复和正确性恢复。

lines.en: Rollback verification shows only 2.7 serving. No new requests reach canary pods.
lines.zh: 回滚验证显示只有2.7提供服务。没有新请求到灰度Pod。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, receipts reconcile? We did roll back the release cleanly?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，回执已核对？这次发布干净回滚了吗？

lines.en: Receipts and running digests match now. The schema expansion remains, as approved.
lines.zh: 回执和运行摘要现在匹配。结构扩展按审批保留。

lines.en: The discount quote smoke test passes. Payment deduplication still works itself.
lines.zh: 折扣报价冒烟测试通过。支付去重机制本身仍正常。

lines.en: Ten fresh minutes of metrics look healthy. Errors point-two percent, p95 two-twenty milliseconds.
lines.zh: 新的十分钟指标正常。错误率0.2%，p95二百二十毫秒。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on old writers. New optional fields haven't blocked writes.
lines.zh: 我关注旧写入代码。新可选字段没有阻塞写入。

lines.en: Matched discount traffic has recovered too. No observed duplicate charges in reconciliation.
lines.zh: 匹配的折扣流量也恢复了。核对未发现重复扣款。

lines.en: So, we're back to baseline for service. The failed candidate remains blocked.
lines.zh: 那么服务回到基线。失败的候选版本继续阻止发布。

lines.en: Archive traces under restricted evidence access. Recovery doesn't erase the regression finding.
lines.zh: 追踪归档为受限证据。恢复不抹掉回归发现。

lines.en: Fair, I'll tell support service recovered. Candidate repair needs fresh tests and approval. The evidence covers both product classes. I'll include that coverage with timestamps.
lines.zh: 明白，我告诉支持团队服务恢复，候选修复需新测试和审批。证据覆盖两类商品，我附上覆盖范围和时间戳。

dialogues.title: 修报价回归，不删除回滚所需兼容性
dialogues.premise: 2.7恢复后观察十分钟健康，2.8候选继续阻止；整理发布复盘。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出阶段化迁移的收缩条件和下一次验收。

lines.en: Expand and contract separates migration stages. We aren't ready for contraction yet.
lines.zh: 先扩展后收缩把迁移拆成阶段。现在还不能收缩。

lines.en: Okay, first action item fixes discount lookup. Anika owns evidence by Thursday.
lines.zh: 好，第一个行动项修折扣查询。Anika周四前负责证据。

lines.en: Add cohort comparison for discount traffic. Today's aggregate dashboard hid that regression initially.
lines.zh: 增加折扣流量分组比较。今天整体面板最初掩盖了回归。

lines.en: Just to confirm, new approval after fixes? We won't reuse today's permission, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，修复后重新审批？不复用今天的许可，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, old versions and rollback paths remain. Remove fields only after compatibility consumers retire.
lines.zh: 对，旧版和回滚路径保留。兼容消费者退役后才移除字段。

lines.en: I'll test pause persistence by Friday. The rollback trigger should survive controller restarts. I'll attach failure-injection results for review. Approval must depend on the tested controller.
lines.zh: 我周五前测试暂停持久性，回滚触发条件应跨控制器重启保留。我附故障注入结果供评审，审批须基于测过的控制器。

lines.en: Also test unknown deployment outcomes explicitly. Receipts should prevent duplicate rollout side effects.
lines.zh: 也明确测试部署结果未知的情况。回执应防止重复发布副作用。

lines.en: So, we'll close the loop Friday. Keep today's candidate unavailable for promotion.
lines.zh: 那么周五反馈闭环。今天的候选保持不可晋级。

lines.en: No schema contraction during that follow-up. It needs its own reviewed migration plan.
lines.zh: 那次跟进不收缩结构。它需要独立评审迁移计划。

lines.en: Fair, maybe we lost rollout time. We didn't trade correctness for the window.
lines.zh: 明白，可能损失了发布时间。但没有为赶窗口牺牲正确性。
